[[Tohneh Jonesh]] is an NPC found in [[Resplendent Makuun]] just outside the portal to [[Bokka Amphitheatre]].

==Location==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Acting is food for the soul! The roar of applause, the rise and fall of fortune. I hope you'll come and see the play...all our effort laid at your feet. Tread upon our dreams with care."''

==Quotes==
:''"I found it! A rare, one-of-a-kind, gold-foil, collector's edition of the perfect script! I studied for weeks, hunted every monster rumored to carry it, fought night after night.... What a stroke of luck!"''

:''"I live and breathe my character. It's the only way to advance, to rise through the levels of quality toward the maximum cap of existence. Don't you agree?"''

==Trivia==
*The end of the dialogue is a reference to [[w:Yeats|Yeats]]' verses ''I have spread my dreams under your feet; Tread softly because you tread upon my dreams.'' in the poem ''He wishes for the Cloths of Heaven''.
